notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for negotiated Willing-to-Acquire continuation after the first candidate cancels. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. Evoked delivery preserves two If Available reservations and continues to the second candidate after cancellation; immediate delivery verifies the standard unavailable boundary and uses a regular pending acquisition for the same negotiated continuation. Both callback models check tags, ownership state, callback ordering, and cleanup without provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisitionIfAvailable, attributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, negotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, and confirmDivestiture with standard ownership callbacks
